selection_status: source-label comparison only; final architecture eligibility requires missing technical and annotation checks
limitations: All supplied material is development, including threshold fitting and architecture comparison.
Exact-content deduplication does not establish independent filming sessions.
Source binary labels are unreviewed; conflicting duplicates are excluded transparently.
Known-timecode hits do not measure event precision, complete event recall, rule classification or legal correctness.
Confidence intervals are unavailable because independent groups are not established.
Inference timings do not establish the full client upload-to-response deadline.
Leave-group-out uses more folds than the specification's recommended maximum of three; it is a provisional diagnostic protocol.

dataset.representative_policy: lexicographically smallest video_id per sha256, chosen without predictions
